venmo_password = [p["password"] for p in passwords if p["account_name"] == "venmo"][0]

```python
friends = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.search_friends(access_token=venmo_login["access_token"], page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    friends.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

melissa = [f for f in friends if f["first_name"] == "Melissa"][0]
print(melissa)
```

    matches.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
